title: In this world, every NPC can only say three things

tts.note: matches the user's MP3 voice (ElevenLabs Liam); swap to elevenlabs Liam TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ when credits allow

lines.text: In this world, every NPC can only say *three* things.
The cop says, Freeze! Stop right there! And, Nice weather.
My mom says, Dinner's ready. Love you. And, Did you see that?
My three lines are, Hey! Nice car! And, Watch it!
I've said them *eight million* times.
Then one day, I saw something the player didn't.
The bridge on Palm Avenue was *cracked*. And the player was racing straight toward it.
I had to warn him. But I only had *three* lines.
So I ran into the road and yelled, *Hey*!
He honked and drove around me.
I chased him. *Nice car*!
He gave me a thumbs up, and kept going.
One line left. I jumped right in front of his car.
*Watch it*!
He slammed the brakes. Two inches from my face.
And right in front of us, the bridge *collapsed*.
He got out. He looked at the bridge. Then at me.
And he said something no player has ever said to an NPC.
Thank you.
In this world, NPCs only get three lines. But that day, I didn't need a *fourth*.
